name: Process / Workflow
purpose: Represent immutable released operational-flow definitions and the append-only work assignment and execution evidence of instances without treating plans as observations or copying reusable procedures.

owns: process family and concurrently valid variants
steps gateways roles and state model
process instances and their pinned definition references
step executions deviations escalations and compensations
delegates: reusable method and procedure editions to WM-ACT-009
atomic act identity to WM-ACT-002 when referenced
organization and performer identity to external masters
policy and rule identity to external knowledge masters
excludes: process execution as proof of method publication
assignment state as evidence of performed work
BPMN or CMMN planned paths as observed trace

relations.purpose: Pin the adopted immutable method or procedure edition operationalized by a released definition.
Reference atomic act evidence without owning act identity or asserting one-to-one cardinality.

operations.effect: Issue one immutable version in a variant lineage.
Create an instance pinned to one released definition.
Create a work item without asserting execution.
Append observed performance with definition and method pins.
Append an explicit departure or exception.
Append a new execution linked to the execution it compensates.
Compute a reproducible projection over a pinned definition and trace.

invariants: Every process instance pins exactly one immutable released definition triple.
Draft definitions are not citable by instances or executions.
Variants are concurrent alternatives; versions form supersession lineages within a variant.
Released definitions and trace events are immutable.
Every step execution repeats the definition and method-edition pins applicable at its start.
Work-item state changes and step executions are distinct facts and either may exist without the other.
A planned path never proves the observed path.
Every known departure is represented by an explicit deviation.
Missing trace evidence is not conformance.
Compensation appends a linked execution and never deletes or rewrites the original.
Conformance and cycle time are reproducible derived projections.
Historical replay uses immutable pins and monotonic event sequence.
A new procedure edition changes execution only after effective adoption.
Atomic-act references never transfer act identity into this aggregate.
holds: Exact Grok review and provider reconciliation are pending.
One frozen no-tools semantic audit of the reconciled candidates is pending.
External notation and standards crosswalks are not conformance claims.
Package conversion and live HTTP/runtime/search/package verification are pending.
WM-ACT-002 cardinality and cross-system BPM/ERP/WMS trace mastership require later crosswalk evidence.
